review_notes: 68 existing definitions across seven files: exact token checks for local-only edits; focused structured review; no new native coverage or gameplay-equivalence claim. One combined incremental build; full audits and reccmp deferred.

Humility shares final cleanup handling while returning directly from handled events. Protection source traversal retains null checks and output update order. Granted flanking clears the same 302-byte marking buffer with sizeof.

Graveyard exile retains the native clear of source IDs for both players, using indexed writes to the same 1000 entries. Reanimation preserves unsupported-mode return behavior, and commander counter handling retains its early exile and return.

Proliferate uses ordinary automatic and manual selection loops with the same can_target, selection, counter-choice and cleanup call order. Automatic experience/energy priorities and selection flags retain recovered behavior.

Blowfly and Blade GFP effects use the previously reviewed lifecycle form; Blowfly still queries targets before checking its remaining count and retries after canceled picks. Reverse permanent scans snapshot the next card before callbacks.

Power Artifact and Time Elemental event routing is structured. Preserve Power Artifact target-change return behavior, casting rechecks, move-aura temporary states and cost-modifier calls. Time Elemental retains attacking versus blocking checks, defensive ratings and destruction flags. Larger duration, battery, counter/AI and aura paths retain their flow under token substitution.
verification_policy: Affected-file hashes and exact token checks for alpha-only edits; focused review for structured edits. Build separately after the combined batch. Inventories and reccmp deferred to a larger checkpoint.
scope: Readability cleanup of existing recovered definitions; no new native coverage or gameplay-equivalence claim.
